items.title: She Retired at 64 in January 2000 With $1 Million and Followed the 4% Rule. Her Neighbor Did the Same Thing in January 2003. By the End of 2025, One Had About $96,000 Left and the Other Had $6.1 Million. Here’s What Every Retiree Needs To Know About Sequence Of Returns Risk
items.source_excerpt: Two retirees, the same $1 million in an S&P 500 index fund, the same 4% rule, three years apart.
